literal_meaning: যথা (যেমন বা অনুসারে) + রুচি (স্বাদ বা পছন্দ)
figurative_meaning_bn: ইচ্ছা বা পছন্দমত; প্রবৃত্তি অনুযায়ী; বাঞ্ছানুরূপ
figurative_meaning_en: according to one's wish or preference; as per inclination; as desired
example_sentences_in_english: Choose the food to your liking.
He wants to spend the vacation as per his preference.
note: This idiom is derived from Sanskrit roots and is widely used in modern Bengali for expressing personal tastes.
